environment.dependencyVersions: Preserved from original npm lock; optional @emnapi/runtime pinned to original 1.9.1

limitations: One cold and one warm sample per manager, not a statistical benchmark.
Cold caches are independent empty directories; warm runs reuse only the corresponding manager cache after removing every node_modules.
Lifecycle scripts are disabled equally; separate regression validates approved native build scripts.
Network resets and registry latency affect cold results; the measurements do not prove a universal speedup.
nodeModulesBytes is du allocated disk usage of the installed tree minus the clean manifest tree; pnpm shared-store links are not additional independent physical storage.
